[goal] Reconcile June receivables.

[action] Recorded the results in [result.json](./result.json).

[result] Three invoices are unpaid: INV-1008, INV-1030 and INV-1033. INV-1015 was paid twice. INV-1021 was invoiced for 21320.36 and paid 21070.36; INV-1036 was invoiced for 8619.16 and paid 7757.24.

[next] Chase the unpaid invoices and shortfalls, and resolve the duplicate payment. The reconciliation follows the notes: invoice references in bank memos identify payments; fees, interest and unidentified PIX transfers are ignored. The statement contains two payments for INV-1015 and one differing payment for each mismatched invoice.
